title: Runtime telemetry sampler for attention pathway and prefill/decode latency profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a low-overhead, request-sampler telemetry path that correlates kernel selection decisions, attention-kernel variant usage, and prefill vs decode timing breakdowns. Goal is to produce per-request latency profiles and a compact per-kernel metrics bundle for sampled requests that can be used by the Console heatmaps and regression alerts without adding measurable tail latency to unsampled traffic. This ticket implements: 1) a sampler with pluggable policy (rate, reservoir, trace-based), 2) named NVTX range taxonomy for attention variants and scheduler boundaries, 3) a compact protobuf/gRPC envelope for per-kernel counters and timelines, and 4) a backend aggregator job that joins sampled telemetry with request metadata to populate Grafana dashboards and the Console's per-route heatmap. We must target <0.5% P99 latency regression for non-sampled requests and keep sampled-request overhead under 10ms on average for the 4k token prefill path.
acceptance_criteria: Sampler implemented in runtime with configurable policies (fixed-rate and reservoir) via config flag
NVTX ranges emitted with consistent naming rules for: prefill-start, prefill-attention-[variant], prefill-kv-merge, decode-start, decode-attention-[variant], kernel-invoke-[kernel-name]
Compact telemetry envelope produced for sampled requests containing: per-kernel elapsed_ms, input shapes, chosen kernel variant, scheduler decision tags, and prefetch/cache-hit flags
End-to-end pipeline: runtime -> telemetry-collector -> aggregator -> Grafana/Console dashboards with sample-join available within 2 minutes
Bench: non-sampled median and P99 latency regression <0.5% in lab perf runs using 8-GPU 80B workload
Dashboards show heatmap by model, route, and selected kernel variant; basic alerts for sudden shifts in kernel mix or prefill/decode ratio
tasks: Design sampler API and default policy (Aisha)
Define NVTX naming taxonomy and add to runtime instrumentation (Diego)
Implement compact telemetry envelope and avoid heavy allocations (runtime team)
Add config switches guarded by feature flag and runtime knob
End-to-end test harness that replays sampled traces into aggregator
Create Grafana panels and Console wiring for heatmap and per-request drilldown
Load test to measure overhead on sampled and unsampled traffic
Write migration notes and update observability runbook
comments: 2025-02-18 - Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created after spike where customers saw regression when attention-kernel selector flipped for model-X. Proposal: sample 1% of requests by default and escalate to trace-based reservoir sampling for tail events.

2025-02-20 - Diego Martinez: Drafted NVTX taxonomy. Key decision: include kernel variant and scheduler reason in NVTX metadata tag rather than embedding long strings in every NVTX event to limit overhead. See draft doc: https://confluence.redwood/rt-telemetry/sampler-taxonomy

2025-02-24 - Diego Martinez: PoC patch emits NVTX ranges with short numeric codes and a small map service for decoding these codes in the aggregator. Link to PoC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2789

2025-02-26 - SRE review (Lina Cho): Concern about telemetry collector QPS during bursts. Action: implement backpressure and bounded buffer in collector and allow sample-rate override per-customer. Marked as blocker for rollout until aggregation backpressure present.

2025-03-01 - Diego Martinez: Implemented compact envelope (proto v2) and micro-bench. Sampled-request median overhead ~6.8ms on 4k prefill, P50 CPU additions ~1.8%. Non-sampled path unaffected in microbench. Perf logs uploaded: https://drive.redwood/p/telemetry/bench-0301

2025-03-03 - Aisha Patel: Reviewed PoC and asked for two changes: 1) include a scheduler-decision hash to help join with policy telemetry, 2) ensure per-kernel counters use delta encoding to compress runs with many tiny kernels. Added these as follow-up tasks.

2025-03-04 - Diego Martinez: Started the aggregator job. Created initial Grafana dashboard. Aggregator design: stream sampled envelopes into a kinesis topic -> worker does decode and enrichment -> writes join results to ClickHouse (short retention) and S3 for raw samples. PR for aggregator: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry-aggregator/pull/112
